beats.text: Every young adult in Austria has a financial account. In Yemen, only 5% do.
Austria hits 100%. Austria has 20 times the value found in Yemen.
Account denotes respondents reporting an account at a financial institution or using mobile money.
India and the USA sit well past the median, with India at 83.3% and the USA at 87.7%.
Yemen falls at the very bottom, with just 5% of young adults owning an account.
How many young adults in your nation use a bank or mobile money?
